summary_rationale.diagonalisation-and-the-minimal-polynomi: This is the page the dispatch names explicitly. Paragraph 1 opened "This page defines diagonalisability and derives the minimal polynomial …" and stayed on the page's own construction throughout; the only dependency material in it (Cayley–Hamilton, the PID property of F[x]) appeared as steps of that construction rather than as background. Paragraph 2 also closed with a claim about other pages — "Triangularisation, Jordan canonical form, and the spectral theorem remain on their assigned downstream pages" — which SCHEMA §6 forbids. The replacement gives paragraph 1 the published eigen-theory, multiplicities, Cayley–Hamilton, polynomial evaluation at an endomorphism, the PID/UFD structure of F[x] with Bézout and monic gcds, splitting, the irreducible quotient and the evaluation-kernel theorem, and confines the whole development, in its logical order, to paragraph 2.
summary_rationale.inner-product-spaces-and-orthogonality: Paragraph 1 opened "This page fixes the standard real/complex definition …" and then listed a dozen results the page proves; the declared dependencies appeared only as a passing reconciliation note. Paragraph 2 ended with a scope disclaimer ("Completeness, Hilbert spaces, infinite orthonormal expansions, and the spectral theorem are excluded"), which is meta-commentary rather than the page's logical progression. The replacement puts the published sesquilinear/Hermitian convention, complex conjugation and modulus, existence of nonnegative real square roots, the finite-sum Cauchy–Schwarz theorem, and the basis/dimension/matrix/determinant machinery in paragraph 1, and gives paragraph 2 the development from the inner product through Cauchy–Schwarz, orthonormalisation, orthogonal decomposition and projections to adjoints and isometries.
